detail: the first cold spec-judge stopped at its governance pre-flight - the conductor running the spec-producer inline had not loaded the oracle, builder and architect spec bars. A real loading gap this time, not only a declaration gap: the bars were loaded, the draft self-aligned against them (two no-request scenarios gained a ratification precondition to avoid contradicting the owner-message-is-an-order outline), and a fresh cold judge re-dispatched.

spec-judge change verdict, builder lens - three sub-graph 6 edges had no scenario-map row (one lost when the old adopt scenario was replaced) and the receiver-never-reads-scope-from-the-thread-record claim had no scenario; fixed by widening two edge cells and adding the record scenario. Advisories folded in - order-channel vs order-content wording, an inert gate scenario dropped, two Givens made scaffoldable, the ambiguous bare-yes edge specified with its own scenario.

spec-judge round two, builder lens - the two answers-no-request scenarios and the revision scenario also passed the pre-repair four-part text, so they did not discriminate the old rule from the new; pre-existing since the first draft, not a regression. Fixed by giving those turns the old four-part envelope, which the old rule would adopt and the new rule does not. Advisories folded - a positive companion branch for the adopt scenario, an unambiguous relayer-addressed aside, the re-raise obligation stated in prose.

spec-judge round three, builder lens - REGRESSION: the round-two envelope on the receiver no-request scenario named a plural scope, which a strict old-rule follower rejects as not one target, so the scenario still passed the pre-repair text. Iteration cap reached; re-planned to one targeted edit (singular target, a named relaying unit on all three enveloped turns) plus one narrow confirmation round, halting rather than looping if it fails.
